notes.title: 🪄 Elder Magic Squad – Development Update 🪄
notes.notes:
Hello, Night4Games here!
We’re wrapping up today’s screenshot dev log—three updates landed in a short burst 💨

🛡️ Shield Counters & Self-Buffs

We added a shield-removal item to counter shielded enemies, and a self-buff item that boosts your power while you have a shield. This should greatly expand build variety!

[previewyoutube=rVFg4bFE9i4;full]Added a new item that removes shields[/previewyoutube]

👑 Guaranteed Boss / Mid-Boss Drops

We implemented guaranteed item drops when defeating bosses and mid-bosses.
Note: It’s been a while since we ran the build, so some effects aren’t rendering correctly—a fix is in progress.

[previewyoutube=Uig4S_kjXas;full]Added new items that always drop when defeating bosses or mid-bosses[/previewyoutube]

✨ Auto-Casting Skill at Attack Location

A new item now triggers a skill magic at the position you attack. With smart positioning and timing, you can set up some fun chains. We plan to add more items of this type during balancing.

[previewyoutube=WIoSURfaWeo;full]Added a new item that triggers a skill magic at the location you attack[/previewyoutube]

We’d love to hear your thoughts in the comments!
#indiegame 🚀 #GameDev 🎮

notes.title: 🪄 Elder Magic Squad – Development Update ✨
notes.notes:
🪄 Elder Magic Squad – Development Update ✨

Hello everyone, this is Night4Games!
Today, we’re excited to share the latest development update for Elder Magic Squad, introducing two new types of items that will change the way you play.

⚔️ Position-Based Damage Item 🎯

We’ve added a new item that boosts your damage depending on enemy distance!

Extra power when striking nearby enemies 🔥

Bonus damage when hitting distant foes 💥

Mastering positioning is the key to maximizing your strength.

[previewyoutube=i4HuffS2nZY;full]⚔️ Boost your damage at close and long range![/previewyoutube]

☠️ Cursed Items & Synergy ⚡

A dangerous but powerful new mechanic—Cursed Items—has been introduced!

Equipping them comes with great risks 💀

But they unlock special items that greatly enhance your abilities ⚡

A true high-risk, high-reward system to push your builds further!

[previewyoutube=G84v38DM_tE;full]☠️ Cursed Items have arrived![/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 🪄 Elder Magic Squad – Development Update 🪄
notes.notes:
🪄 Elder Magic Squad – Development Update 🪄
Status Effect Combo Showcase!

Hello everyone, this is Night4Games!
Today we’d like to introduce some of the status effect combos being implemented in Elder Magic Squad.
These synergies can dramatically change your gameplay—check out the screenshots and videos below!

💀 + 🔥 → 💥 Poison × Flame Explosion

When poison combines with fire, it triggers a powerful explosion!
Perfect for wiping out enemies with a burst attack.
(Damage values are still being adjusted)

[previewyoutube=u020AaVY9gI;full]💀 + 🔥 = 💥 Poison × Flame Explosion (Damage values are being adjusted)[/previewyoutube]

☠️ + ❄️ → ☠️☠️ Enhanced Poison (Double Effect)

The chill of ice concentrates the poison.
It deals double the effect compared to normal poison, making it shine in long battles.

[previewyoutube=q6W0zqs4Xnk;full]☠️ + ❄️ = ☠️☠️ Enhanced Poison (Double Effect)[/previewyoutube]

⚡ + 🕸️ → ⚡🌐 Electric Shock Around You

Channel lightning through spider webs to electrify surrounding enemies.
A thrilling combo that shocks and blasts away clustered foes!

[previewyoutube=MUvbhnuTjN4;full]⚡ + 🕸️ = ⚡🌐 Electric Shock Around You[/previewyoutube]

🔮 What’s Next

These are just a few of the many combos being prepared.
Elder Magic Squad will feature even more diverse combinations in future updates—please look forward to it!

💡 If you haven’t yet, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist!

notes.title: April 2025 Progress Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Squad! April has been packed with new features and improvements. Here’s a quick rundown:

◆ Progress Reporting Script
We’ve built a new automation script to streamline our monthly progress reports—seamlessly uploading to YouTube and compiling updates for Steam News. ​


◆ New Buffs
🔥 Skill Growth Buff – Each time you use a skill, the buff increases in strength over time.
👾 Elite Slayer Buff – Defeat 30 enemies to unlock a powerful buff. ​

[previewyoutube=uSWK-KmBHDQ;full]Skill Growth Buff Preview[/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=g66QvZ1I988;full]Elite Slayer Buff Preview[/previewyoutube]

◆ New Items
🛡️ Defense HP Recovery – Using Defense now restores a portion of your HP.
⚔️ Automatic Defense Trigger – Take damage and watch your Defense activate automatically.
💸 Discount Token – Enjoy a 10% off purchase on in-game items. ​

[previewyoutube=H4AzXKCoSt4;full]Automatic Defense Demo[/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=JT46T4jxygk;full]Discount Token Showcase[/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your continued support! Don’t forget to add Elder Magic Squad to your wishlist and stay tuned for more updates! 🚀

notes.title: 💫 Elder Magic Squad – January & February Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! Here’s a quick roundup of everything we’ve been working on for Elder Magic Squad over the past two months.

🆕 Feb 24 – Inventory Slot Expansion Item
We added a brand‑new item that increases your inventory capacity. Simply equip it to carry more gear and open up fresh strategic options!

[previewyoutube=pZ7MoGMfP0c;full][/previewyoutube]

💡 Feb 20 – “Wanted Effects” Survey
We asked, “What kind of item effects or slot types would you like?” Your ideas are now in the planning stage—thanks for the great feedback!

🔑 Feb 20 – Key Item Added
Keys can now be found in dungeons to unlock special areas. We’ll keep fine‑tuning the drop routes and rates as we go. (See the clip at 0:11.)

⚔️ Feb 15 – Attack‑Only Slot
A new slot dedicated to offensive abilities has been introduced. Expect more slots that boost stats or add unique effects soon!

🪄 Feb 11 – Wand Customization Overhaul
We’ve revamped the wand enhancement system. More slot types are on the way, giving you even greater freedom to craft your build. (Footage at 0:55.)

🎨 Jan 26 – UI Polish Resumed
Work has resumed on our long‑awaited UI overhaul. We’ll showcase the new design in a future update! (Clip at 0:29.)

Have feedback or requests? Let us know on the Steam Community Hub!

See you in the next update—thanks for your support! 🧙‍♂️✨

— Night Four Games Dev Team
